---

## Zero Handling Before CLR Transformation

```{r zero_handling_function}
# Multiplicative zero replacement
# Input: matrix/dataframe where each ROW is a sample and each COL is a taxon
# Output: zero-replaced matrix where each row still sums to 1
multiplicative_zero_replacement <- function(x, delta = NULL) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  
  # Normalise to proportion [0,1] if data are in percentage format (row sums ~ 100)
  row_totals <- rowSums(x)
  if (mean(row_totals) > 1.1) {
    x <- x / row_totals
    cat("  [Zero replacement] Data normalised from % to proportion (row sum = 1).\n")
  }
  
  # If delta is not specified, use half the minimum non-zero value
  if (is.null(delta)) {
    min_nonzero <- min(x[x > 0])
    delta <- min_nonzero / 2
  }
  cat("  [Zero replacement] Delta =", delta, "\n")
  
  # Apply row-wise (per sample)
  x_replaced <- t(apply(x, 1, function(row) {
    zeros    <- row == 0
    n_zeros  <- sum(zeros)
    
    if (n_zeros == 0) return(row)
    
    row_new         <- row
    row_new[zeros]  <- delta
    # Rescale non-zero values so row sum remains 1
    scale_factor    <- (1 - n_zeros * delta)
    row_new[!zeros] <- row[!zeros] * scale_factor
    
    return(row_new)
  }))
  
  return(x_replaced)
}

# CLR transformation
# Input: zero-replaced matrix (no zeros present)
clr_transform <- function(x) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  t(apply(x, 1, function(row) {
    log(row) - mean(log(row))
  }))
}
```

## Input Data

```{r input_data}
file_xlsx <- here("data", "species_abundance.xlsx")
df0 <- as.data.frame(read_excel(file_xlsx, sheet = "species_relabund"))

rownames(df0) <- df0[[1]]
df <- as.data.frame(df0[, -1])
df[] <- lapply(df, as.numeric)
df  <- t(df)   # rows = samples, cols = species

cat("Samples:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Species:", ncol(df), "\n")
cat("Zero count in data:", sum(df == 0), 
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * mean(df == 0)))
cat("Min non-zero value:", min(df[df > 0]), "\n")
```

---

## CLR Transformation and Aitchison Distance

```{r aitchison_distance}
# 1. Zero replacement
df_replaced <- multiplicative_zero_replacement(df)

cat("Post zero-replacement check:\n")
cat("  Any zeros remaining:", any(df_replaced == 0), "\n")
cat("  Row sums (first 5 samples):", round(rowSums(df_replaced)[1:5], 6), "\n")

# 2. CLR transformation
df_clr <- clr_transform(df_replaced)
rownames(df_clr) <- rownames(df)
colnames(df_clr) <- colnames(df)

cat("\nCLR transformation:\n")
cat("  Dimensions:", dim(df_clr), "\n")
cat("  Row means ≈ 0 (check, first 5 samples):", 
    round(rowMeans(df_clr)[1:5], 8), "\n")

# 3. Aitchison distance = Euclidean distance on CLR-transformed data
aitchison_dist <- dist(df_clr, method = "euclidean")

# Export distance matrix
aitchison_matrix <- as.matrix(aitchison_dist)
write.xlsx(aitchison_matrix,
           file = file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "aitchison_matrix.xlsx")),
           rowNames = TRUE)

cat("\nAitchison distance matrix exported.\n")
cat("Range:", round(range(aitchison_dist), 3), "\n")
```

## Export Intermediate Files

```{r export_clr_crosscheck}
wb_check <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: Raw abundance (original input)
addWorksheet(wb_check, "1_raw_abundance")
writeData(wb_check, "1_raw_abundance",
          cbind(SampleID = rownames(df), as.data.frame(df)))

# Sheet 2: After zero replacement
addWorksheet(wb_check, "2_zero_replaced")
writeData(wb_check, "2_zero_replaced",
          cbind(SampleID = rownames(df_replaced), as.data.frame(df_replaced)))

# Sheet 3: Row sum check after replacement (expected = 1)
row_sums <- rowSums(df_replaced)
addWorksheet(wb_check, "3_rowsums_check")
writeData(wb_check, "3_rowsums_check",
          data.frame(SampleID = rownames(df_replaced),
                     RowSum    = round(row_sums, 8),
                     OK        = abs(row_sums - 1) < 1e-6))

# Sheet 4: CLR-transformed values
addWorksheet(wb_check, "4_clr_transformed")
writeData(wb_check, "4_clr_transformed",
          cbind(SampleID = rownames(df_clr), as.data.frame(df_clr)))

# Sheet 5: Row mean check after CLR (expected ≈ 0)
row_means <- rowMeans(df_clr)
addWorksheet(wb_check, "5_rowmeans_check")
writeData(wb_check, "5_rowmeans_check",
          data.frame(SampleID = rownames(df_clr),
                     RowMean   = round(row_means, 8),
                     OK        = abs(row_means) < 1e-6))

# Sheet 6: Aitchison distance matrix
addWorksheet(wb_check, "6_aitchison_distance")
writeData(wb_check, "6_aitchison_distance",
          cbind(SampleID = rownames(aitchison_matrix),
                as.data.frame(aitchison_matrix)))

# Save workbook
crosscheck_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "CLR_crosscheck.xlsx"))
saveWorkbook(wb_check, crosscheck_path, overwrite = TRUE)

# Quick summary
cat("======= CROSS-CHECK SUMMARY =======\n")
cat("Sheet 1 | Raw abundance  — row sums:\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(rowSums(df)), 4),
    "| Max:", round(max(rowSums(df)), 4),
    "  (expected: all = 1)\n")
cat("Sheet 2 | Zero-replaced  — row sums:\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(row_sums), 8),
    "| Max:", round(max(row_sums), 8),
    "  (expected: all = 1)\n")
cat("  Any zeros remaining:", any(df_replaced == 0), "\n")
cat("Sheet 4 | CLR-transformed — row means:\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(row_means), 8),
    "| Max:", round(max(row_means), 8),
    "  (expected: all ≈ 0)\n")
cat("Sheet 6 | Aitchison dist  — diagonal:\n")
diag_vals <- diag(aitchison_matrix)
cat("  Diagonal:", round(min(diag_vals), 8), "–", round(max(diag_vals), 8),
    "  (expected: all = 0)\n")
cat("  Off-diagonal range:",
    round(min(aitchison_matrix[lower.tri(aitchison_matrix)]), 3), "–",
    round(max(aitchison_matrix[lower.tri(aitchison_matrix)]), 3), "\n")
cat("File saved:", crosscheck_path, "\n")
cat("====================================\n")
```

## Load Metadata

```{r load_metadata}
metadata <- read_excel(here("data", "metadata.xlsx"), sheet = "metadata")
colnames(metadata)[1] <- "SampleID"
metadata$Enterotype <- as.factor(metadata$Enterotype)

metadata_ordered <- metadata[match(rownames(df_clr), metadata$SampleID), ]

cat("Samples:", nrow(metadata_ordered), "\n")
cat("Enterotypes:", levels(metadata_ordered$Enterotype), "\n")
print(table(metadata_ordered$Enterotype))
```

---

## PERMANOVA with Aitchison Distance

```{r permanova_aitchison}
# PERMANOVA on Aitchison distance
# Note: no need to specify method = "euclidean" in adonis2 since
# a pre-computed distance object is passed directly
set.seed(123)
permanova_result <- adonis2(aitchison_dist ~ Enterotype,
                            data = metadata_ordered,
                            permutations = 999)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA (Aitchison Distance) ===\n")
print(permanova_result)

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat("- R² =", round(permanova_result$R2[1], 4),
    ": proportion of variance explained by Enterotype\n")
cat("- p-value =", permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1], "\n")
if (permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05) {
  cat("=> Significant difference in community composition between enterotypes (p < 0.05)\n")
} else {
  cat("=> No significant difference in community composition (p >= 0.05)\n")
}
```

---

## Homogeneity of Dispersion Test (Betadisper)

```{r betadisper}
betadisper_result <- betadisper(aitchison_dist, metadata_ordered$Enterotype)

cat("\n=== Betadisper (Aitchison) ===\n")
print(betadisper_result)

anova_betadisper <- anova(betadisper_result)
print(anova_betadisper)

set.seed(123)
perm_betadisper <- permutest(betadisper_result, pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 999)
print(perm_betadisper)

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
p_disp <- perm_betadisper$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]
if (p_disp < 0.05) {
  cat("- p =", round(p_disp, 4), "< 0.05: Significant dispersion heterogeneity between enterotypes\n")
  cat("  → Interpret PERMANOVA with caution (result may reflect both centroid and dispersion differences)\n")
} else {
  cat("- p =", round(p_disp, 4), ">= 0.05: Homogeneous dispersion between enterotypes\n")
  cat("  → PERMANOVA result reflects true centroid differences\n")
}

png(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "betadisper_aitchison_boxplot.png")),
    width = 7, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
boxplot(betadisper_result, main = "Distance to Centroid (Aitchison)")
dev.off()
```

## PCoA with Aitchison Distance

```{r pcoa_aitchison}
pcoa_res <- cmdscale(aitchison_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
pcoa_points <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
colnames(pcoa_points) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_points$SampleID <- rownames(pcoa_points)

eig_vals <- pcoa_res$eig
var_exp  <- eig_vals[1:2] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]) * 100
xlab_pcoa <- sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1])
ylab_pcoa <- sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])

plot_df <- merge(pcoa_points, metadata, by = "SampleID")

subtitle_text <- sprintf(
  "PERMANOVA: R² = %.3f, p = %.3f | Betadisper p = %.3f",
  permanova_result$R2[1],
  permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1],
  p_disp
)

# Basic plot
p_basic <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Enterotype)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title    = "PCoA - Aitchison Distance (CLR-transformed)",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    x = xlab_pcoa,
    y = ylab_pcoa,
    color = "Enterotype"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "right")

print(p_basic)

# Plot with 95% confidence ellipses
p_ellipse <- p_basic +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Enterotype, color = Enterotype),
               level = 0.95, type = "t", linetype = 2)
print(p_ellipse)

# Plot with sample labels
p_with_labels <- p_ellipse +
  geom_text(aes(label = SampleID), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5, show.legend = FALSE)
print(p_with_labels)

# Save workbook
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "PCoA_aitchison_basic.png")),
       p_basic, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "PCoA_aitchison_ellipse.png")),
       p_ellipse, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "PCoA_aitchison_ellipse_ID.png")),
       p_with_labels, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)

cat("PCoA plots saved.\n")
```

## Pairwise PERMANOVA (if > 2 groups)

```{r pairwise_permanova}
if (length(levels(metadata_ordered$Enterotype)) > 2) {
  groups <- levels(metadata_ordered$Enterotype)
  pairwise_results <- data.frame(
    Comparison  = character(),
    R2          = numeric(),
    F_statistic = numeric(),
    p_value     = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (i in 1:(length(groups) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):length(groups)) {
      idx      <- metadata_ordered$Enterotype %in% c(groups[i], groups[j])
      sub_dist <- as.dist(as.matrix(aitchison_dist)[idx, idx])
      sub_meta <- metadata_ordered[idx, ]
      set.seed(123)
      sub_perm <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ Enterotype, data = sub_meta, permutations = 999)
      pairwise_results <- rbind(pairwise_results, data.frame(
        Comparison  = paste(groups[i], "vs", groups[j]),
        R2          = sub_perm$R2[1],
        F_statistic = sub_perm$F[1],
        p_value     = sub_perm$`Pr(>F)`[1]
      ))
    }
  }

  pairwise_results$p_adjusted <- p.adjust(pairwise_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  cat("\n=== Pairwise PERMANOVA (Aitchison) ===\n")
  print(pairwise_results)
  write.xlsx(pairwise_results,
             file = file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "pairwise_PERMANOVA_aitchison.xlsx")))
} else {
  cat("Only 2 enterotypes — pairwise comparison not required.\n")
}
```

## Summary Report

```{r summary}
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Test       = c("PERMANOVA (Aitchison)", "Betadisper (Aitchison)"),
  Distance   = c("Aitchison (CLR + Euclidean)", "Aitchison (CLR + Euclidean)"),
  Statistic  = c(
    sprintf("R² = %.4f, F = %.4f", permanova_result$R2[1], permanova_result$F[1]),
    sprintf("F = %.4f", anova_betadisper$`F value`[1])
  ),
  p_value    = c(
    permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    anova_betadisper$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  ),
  Significant = c(
    ifelse(permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    ifelse(anova_betadisper$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  )
)

cat("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary_stats)

write.xlsx(summary_stats,
           file = file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "statistical_summary_aitchison.xlsx")))
```
